finding.title: Duplicate JSON keys bypassed raw payload tamper detection
finding.attack: After dropping the update trigger, raw payload bytes were changed from one canonical key to duplicate keys whose final value preserved the decoded event. The trigger was exactly restored.
finding.consequence: Raw frozen-log bytes could change without changing the canonical event hash, and external JSON could carry parser-order ambiguity at authority-bearing fields.
finding.required_repair: Reject duplicate keys at every admitted JSON parse and require stored payload_json bytes to equal the exact canonical encoding used by the event hash.

nonclaim: Local parser and canonical-storage integrity finding; protected external witnesses remain required against privileged full-chain rewriting.
